PHOTO FILE - UNIT 2 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 145). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 2'.

OCh KO'K XAT QOG'OZI (rasmli bo'shliqlar bilan):
'18th July ......'
'Dear Tony, My name is Steve Evans. I am fifteen years old and I live in Blackpool, England.'
'There are four of us in our family: my parents Bill and Karen, my sister Gina, aged twelve, and me. My father is a [RASM: doskada o'qituvchi] ...... . He works in a primary school. My mother is a [RASM: hamshira] ...... at the local hospital. We live in a big [RASM: katta oq uy] ...... with a lovely garden, about half an hour from the city centre.'
'My school is about [RASM: '2 KM' belgisi] ...... from our house. I always go by [RASM: velosiped] ...... . It usually takes [RASM: '20 mins' belgisi] ...... and it's good exercise. I usually leave home at [RASM: soat 8:20] ...... and get to school at [RASM: soat 8:40] ...... . Lessons finish at [RASM: soat 3:30] ...... . When I get back home, I have a snack and then [RASM: o'g'il bola o'qiyapti/uy vazifasi] ...... . After that we have dinner, then I [RASM: televizor] ...... . At the weekends, we often go to the [RASM: plyaj] ...... by [RASM: qizil mashina] ...... . It takes nearly an [RASM: '1 HR' belgisi] ...... to get there, because there are traffic jams sometimes, so it can be very slow. We don't mind, though.'
'Well, that's all about me. Please write back soon and tell me about yourself. Best wishes, Steve'

⚠ Bu 13-betdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon: 'Look at the Photo File section and complete Steve's letter to his new pen-friend.'

exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TARJIMASI (to'ldirilgan):

18-iyul
Aziz Tony,
Mening ismim Steve Evans. Men o'n
besh yoshdaman va Angliyaning
Blackpool shahrida yashayman.

Oilamizda to'rt kishimiz: ota-onam
Bill va Karen, o'n ikki yoshli
singlim Gina va men. Otam -
O'QITUVChI. U boshlang'ich maktabda
ishlaydi. Onam mahalliy kasalxonada
HAMShIRA. Biz shahar markazidan yarim
soatlik masofada, chiroyli bog'li
katta UYda yashaymiz.

Maktabim uyimizdan taxminan IKKI
KILOMETR narida. Men har doim
VELOSIPEDDA boraman. Bu odatda
YIGIRMA DAQIQA oladi va yaxshi
jismoniy mashq. Odatda uydan SAKKIZ
YIGIRMADA chiqaman va maktabga
TO'QQIZGA YIGIRMA QOLGANDA yetib
boraman. Darslar TO'RTGA YaRIMDA
tugaydi. Uyga qaytganimda yengil
tamaddi qilaman, keyin UY VAZIFAMNI
QILAMAN. Undan keyin kechki ovqat
qilamiz, keyin TELEVIZOR KO'RAMAN.
Dam olish kunlari biz ko'pincha
MAShINADA PLYaJGA boramiz. U yerga
yetib borish deyarli BIR SOAT oladi,
chunki ba'zan tirbandlik bo'ladi,
shuning uchun juda sekin bo'lishi
mumkin. Lekin biz qarshi emasmiz.

Xo'sh, men haqimda shu. Iltimos, tez
orada javob yoz va o'zing haqingda
ayt.
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Steve


JAVOBLAR (rasmlardan):
  1 teacher  2 nurse  3 house
  4 two kilometres  5 bike (bicycle)
  6 twenty minutes  7 twenty past
  eight  8 twenty to nine  9 half
  past three  10 do my homework
  11 watch TV  12 beach  13 car
  14 hour


⚠ 'A PEN-FRIEND':

  = yozishma do'sti.


⚠ 'THERE ARE FOUR OF US':

  = biz to'rt kishimiz.


⚠ 'AGED TWELVE':

  = o'n ikki yoshli.


⚠ 'PRIMARY SCHOOL':

  = boshlang'ich maktab.


⚠ 'IT TAKES + VAQT':

  = ... vaqt oladi.


⚠ 'A SNACK':

  = yengil tamaddi.


⚠ 'A TRAFFIC JAM':

  = tirbandlik.


⚠ "WE DON'T MIND, THOUGH":

  = Lekin biz qarshi emasmiz.
  ⚠ 'though' gap oxirida = lekin.


⚠ 'THAT'S ALL ABOUT ME':

  = men haqimda shu.

exercises.instructionEn: Now write a similar letter about yourself to a pen-friend.

exercises.explanationUz:
STEVE XATINING TUZILIShI:
  1 Sana, murojaat (Dear ...)
  2 Ism, yosh, yashash joyi
  3 Oila: kim, kasbi, uy
  4 Maktab: masofa, transport, vaqt
  5 Kundalik tartib: uydan chiqish,
    darslar, uyga qaytish, kechqurun
  6 Dam olish kunlari
  7 Xayrlashish (Best wishes)

  ⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE (2-unit).
  ⚠ Takrorlanish ravishlari:
  always, usually, often.

modelAnswers:
Dear Anna,

My name is Dilshod. I am fourteen years old and I live in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

There are five of us in our family: my parents, my two brothers and me. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. We live in a flat near the city centre.

My school is about one kilometre from our house, so I always walk. I usually leave home at half past seven and lessons finish at one o'clock. When I get home, I have lunch and do my homework. In the evening I watch TV or play football with my friends.

At the weekends, we often visit my grandparents in the countryside.

Well, that's all about me. Please write back soon.
Best wishes,
Dilshod
